title: Settings
hideAmountsDescription: Hide all amounts for shoulder-surfing protection
localOnlyDescription: No sync. Data lives on this device only.
deleteAllDataMessage: This permanently deletes all local budget data from this device. There is no undo.
encryptionNotEnabled: Encrypt your data with a password only you know before it syncs.
encryptionEnabled: On. Your data is encrypted before syncing. Regenerate the key to change the password.
encryptionNoServer: Available only when connected to a server.
disconnectMessage: Disconnect from this server? Local data will be cleared.
repairSyncMessage: Rebuilds the local sync state from this device's history and re-syncs with the server. Use this if sync keeps failing or getting stuck.
formattingNote: Formatting does not affect how budget data is stored, and can be changed at any time.
payeesCreatedAuto: Payees are created automatically when you add transactions.
rulesAutoApplied: Rules are applied automatically when transactions are imported.
resetSyncDisabled: Reset sync is only available when syncing is enabled.
resetSyncConfirmMessage: This removes local sync tracking and creates a fresh sync ID on the server. Other devices will have to re-download this budget.
resetSyncFailed: Couldn't reset sync. Check your connection and try again.
repairMismatched: {{count}} split(s) have mismatched totals — review them manually.
experimentalFeaturesWarning: These features are still in development. They may be unstable or cause data issues, and they sync across all your devices. Some aren't available on this device yet — enabling them has no effect until they're supported. Use with caution.
addSpace: Add space between amount and symbol
currencyNote: Currency settings affect how amounts are displayed throughout the app. Changing the currency also sets the number format, symbol position, and whether decimals are shown — all adjustable afterward.
